description: Ramp length for a rise at the Ontario Building Code 1 in 12 gradient, a slope check, or a doorway clear width check, using Section 3.8. Preliminary planning only. Example: /api/tools/accessible-ramp-and-doorway-calculator?mode=len&units=mm&rise=600

door.description: Which doorway (mode door): path = barrier-free path of travel; suite-wide = bathroom or bedroom door in a suite served by a corridor 1,060 mm or wider; suite-narrow = same, corridor narrower than 1,060 mm

mode.description: len = ramp length needed for a rise (needs rise); slope = check an existing slope (needs rise and run); door = doorway clear width (needs width and door)

units.description: Units of rise, run and width

width.description: Clear width with the door open (mode door) (units)

name: accessible-ramp-and-doorway-calculator
title: Accessible ramp and doorway calculator
